name: song_arm_signed_continuous_replay_exploratory
stream: Whole raw EMG/IMU HDF5; 25-sample EMG chunks, causal 40 Hz high-pass plus 50/100 Hz notch, 50 EMG samples and 22 indexed IMU samples per frame, 25-sample global hop and IMU watermark, identical to frozen baseline continuous replay
candidate_model: Frozen tracked baseline hand runtime plus source-only balanced logistic arm model with 13 baseline F6 and six signed device-axis quantities; independently verify candidate against trial-level saved probabilities before stream replay
event_rule: Top joint class at probability >= 0.15 for three consecutive emitted frames; unchanged from baseline
score: Same full-window cue-labelled formal-stable intervals and two explicit rest-stable intervals as frozen baseline; report joint/hand/arm window metrics, trial mean-joint-probability metrics, explicit rest active-hand argmax/display, emitted and dropped frames and transition counts
selection: No threshold/model adjustment on S03/S04 after seeing replay. S04 has been inspected and remains descriptive. Do not promote to live UI solely on same-person/day replay.
scope: No physiological action onset label, hardware latency, new-day/person or independent device-axis calibration. Unlabelled frames cannot be counted as false positives.
